# Collatz Findings

## Assumptions

- Sample A and Sample B random ranges were interpreted as odd integers drawn without replacement from 1 to 1,000,000 because the prompt omitted explicit upper bounds.
- Plot C colors use v2(3n+1) mod 4 as the first nontrivial 2-adic seed signature, because v2(n)=0 for every odd starting integer.
- Top-30 equivalence-class analysis is centered on Sample B, the 100,000-member odd random sample, because the prompt emphasizes that scale as the main result.
- Trajectory heatmaps use log10(value + 1) for display while the saved CSV retains the raw interpolated values.

## 5. Formal claims

1. Claim 1: Within stopping-time equivalence classes of the Collatz map, peak trajectory magnitude and peak iteration index are inversely correlated across the modal equivalence classes. In this run, the class-wise Pearson coefficients produced t = 22.2787, p = 8.64794e-20, with negative correlation in 0 of the top classes.
2. Claim 2: A statistically significant fraction of modal stopping-time equivalence classes exhibit internal stratification into distinct subfamilies. In this run, 30 of 30 top classes were stratified by the dip/KDE criterion, and 30 classes also showed significant 2-adic profile separation.
